name: cd_subsystem_init
rationale: CD subsystem bring-up: CdInit + CdGetToc + OpenEvent/EnableEvent (CD-ready event) with a printf banner.

name: display_env_setup
rationale: Initializes the display/draw environments (SetDefDrawEnv/SetDefDispEnv), clears the frame (ClearImage) and the ordering table (ClearOTagR).

name: boot_video_audio_init
rationale: Boot init step from the shell state machine: ResetGraph/ResetCallback + boot_subsystem_init + VAB audio-bank load.

name: gameplay_frame_render
rationale: Per-frame in-game render: drives the scene (scene_render_driver) then composites the HUD (hud_draw_*).

name: spu_voice_key_onoff
rationale: Keys SPU voices on/off (SsUtKeyOnV/SsUtKeyOffV) for a sound/music event.

name: frame_present
rationale: Flushes and presents a frame: draws the ordering table (DrawOTag) and swaps the display environment (PutDispEnv).

name: sound_voice_trigger
rationale: play_sound's worker: computes a distance/attenuation (SquareRoot0) and keys a SPU voice (SsUtKeyOn).

name: effect_mesh_transform
rationale: Transforms effect geometry for the effect spawner: builds rotation+translation matrices and interpolates them (RotAverage4).

name: queue_draw_prim
rationale: Appends a GPU primitive to the draw list (AddPrim) with a draw-mode set (SetDrawMode).

name: scene_flow_dispatcher
rationale: Top-level scene/flow dispatch: routes between FMV playback, the gameplay state machine, and level transitions.

name: player_contact_response
rationale: Player contact/collision response (from player_vertical_update): spawns drops + contact objects, plays sounds, reskins pickup tokens.

name: level_chunk_loader
rationale: Loads a level asset chunk: builds a filename (strcat/strcpy), loads it (universal_file_loader), and welds the mesh (chunk_mesh_weld_converter).
